It makes me infuriated each time and determined to never use Expedia for any purpose.

reviews.title: Front "page" tech issues
reviews.text: I have subscribed for years and read daily.  I've generally found this easy and informative but lately many of the articles on the Top Stories section don't open when I try to tap/open them - very odd.  I have to search for the key words in the article title, then I can open from the search page.  Is it my phone?  Don't know but the sports section still showing NBA as the first sport even though the season has been over for months is definitely not my phone.  The ability to personalize the sports section was removed for a while now (maybe a year?), but that hadn't worked as intended for a couple years (it would lose the personalization and revert to standard every time).  So now I get the sports scores and schedules elsewhere.  If this tapping on the Top Stories section articles continues, I'll have to switch my news app, too.
